header.description: What: Test-town. An M1 "Tank" stands in the open at (262,195), FACING WEST towards the threat, 45 m north of the 15 m block's north leg (x 230-250, y 110-150), serving under an idle "Tank Platoon" HQ — ⭐ CE-4703: contact is its commander's, so it HOLDS until a missile is launched at it (its own reaction); "Shooter", an M2 Bradley 165 m west (100,225), is told to attack it (LandPlatformAttack) with its TOW. ⭐ Why staged so (backend, 2026-11-27, unreal-ig's live report): with the tank free to react to first contact the outcome was a RACE — it reached a true hide before the TOW was ready on some runs (live: nothing fired) and not on others; facing EAST every TOW struck its rear and took its mobility, so it could never back out. Judge: (1) the Bradley launches a TOW at the tank (2) within 3 s of the launch the tank fires ONE salvo of its smoke dischargers (mount 2) at the Bradley — the fan of grenades bursts 30 m out between them (3) the tank leaves the open: it backs out of the Bradley's sight into its own hide (~288,227 from this start, measured CE-4691; it chooses it, the cover search) (5) the Bradley never hits it again after the screen (4) a second salvo never follows the first within 30 s. Fail: no salvo, a salvo without a launch, or the tank stays in the open. CE-4670 VA-S5, DESIGN_Vehicle_Appearance_State §6f.
